visualCharacteristics: Clean white cards on a cool light-gray background
3-4 column responsive card grid on desktop
Deep blue icons and key accents
Strong visual hierarchy using icon → title → short description
Hover behavior limited to slight elevation, border emphasis, and shadow increase
Avoid dense dashboard charts on directory pages
Prioritize discoverability and fast tool selection
calculatorDirectory.overall: The calculator directory should visually resemble a modern energy-management dashboard tool grid rather than a traditional text-heavy utility directory.

calculatorDetail.primaryPrinciple: Users should immediately understand where to enter values and where the result appears. The calculation interface must be significantly simpler than the homepage and tool directory.
layout: Inputs grouped vertically or in a simple responsive grid
Formula / assumptions / examples placed below using progressive disclosure
avoid: Charts unless essential to understanding the calculation
Marketing content inside the active calculation workflow

desktop.complexCalculator: input panel on left, result panel on right

calculatorDetail.overall: The calculator screen must feel closer to a professional engineering instrument than a marketing dashboard.

pageHierarchyVisualRule.rule: Do not apply dashboard complexity uniformly across all pages. The visual density must decrease as the user moves from discovery → tool selection → actual calculation.
